title: Diastolic dYsfunctioN AssessMent in critICally Ill Patients
brief_summary: The role of the left ventricular diastolic function (LVDD) in the weaning failure from mechanical ventilation in unclear. Specifically, is unclear whether the outcome of the weaning process could be affected by a pre-existing LVDD (before ICU admission), or by the worsening of a chronic pattern, or by a de-novo LVDD presentation.
study_population: Critically ill patients admitted to General ICU
